name: Good Newt 78
author: Navarog21
description: Neon gradient cyan radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, transform becomes scale(0.8), box-shadow becomes 0 20px 20px #00c6fb. Clicking it toggles it: filter becomes hue-rotate(330deg), starts the 2s animation, transform becomes scale(0.8).
